items.question: What does Section E include in its description of good health?

options.A: Feeling well in both body and mind

items.explanation: Both body and mind are mentioned; health is not reduced to wealth.

items.question: What word does the passage use for health-maintaining rules and practices?
What does a balanced diet contain according to the lesson?

options.C: Nutrients and water in suitable proportions

items.explanation: The listed components include carbohydrates, fat, protein, vitamins, minerals and water.

items.question: When does the lesson say to wash hands in relation to meals?
items.explanation: This is one of the listed personal hygiene practices.

items.question: What does the lesson say about food and water?

options.A: Food should be fresh and clean, and water pure
options.C: All food must be eaten raw

items.explanation: The source stresses food cleanliness and pure water, not appearance alone.

items.question: How long does Simon say he jogs in the morning?
items.explanation: The complete F2 text supplies the duration; the listening gaps are not guessed.

items.question: How often does Simon say he does yoga?

activities.instruction: Answer using the cited text. Equivalent accurate wording is acceptable; support interpretations with details.

items.question: What is hygiene in the passage?
items.modelAnswer: Hygiene means the rules and practices of keeping good health.

items.question: Name four things the passage considers essential for good health.
items.modelAnswer: Suitable food and nutrition, physical exercise, adequate rest and sleep, and cleanliness are four examples. The passage also mentions proper medical care.

items.question: What does the lesson mean by a balanced diet?
items.modelAnswer: It means food containing carbohydrates, fat, protein, vitamins, minerals and water in appropriate proportions.

items.question: Give three personal hygiene practices from the lesson.
items.modelAnswer: Wash hands before eating, bathe regularly and wear clean clothes, and brush teeth regularly. Other accurate practices listed in the passage are acceptable.

items.question: Describe Simon’s exercise routine using the complete F2 text.
items.modelAnswer: He usually exercises every day, jogging for half an hour in the morning and playing table tennis in the afternoon almost regularly. He sometimes plays football and does yoga once a week.

activities.instruction: Write a short paragraph about healthy habits using Section E. Do not give medication instructions.
activities.modelAnswer: Healthy habits support our body and mind. We should eat a varied, balanced diet, drink safe water and keep our food clean. Washing hands before meals and keeping our clothes and surroundings clean are useful habits. Regular activity, suitable rest and enough sleep are important too. When I feel unwell, I tell a trusted adult so that I can get appropriate care. I do not take medicine on my own. Different people have different health needs, so a qualified health professional can guide us when necessary. These habits support health, but being ill is never a reason to blame or shame someone.
activities.note: Original supportive writing model, not a medical prescription. No drug names, doses or claims that habits guarantee freedom from illness.
